# 🧾 Combined Purchase + Sale Invoice Extractor

Automated extraction and reconciliation pipeline for B2B invoices:
- **Sale invoices** — Standard ERP/Tally-generated Tax Invoices
- **Purchase invoices** — Enterprise SAP-generated Tax Invoices

Upload any mix of PDFs — the tool auto-detects formats, extracts line items, and matches purchase lines to sales invoices raised for the same product. Matched pairs are merged into a unified **Combined Register** sheet showing Purchase Cost, Sale Price, and Gross Profit side by side.

# Install dependencies (quiet)
!pip install -q pdfplumber openpyxl ipywidgets

# ---- Colab UI: Upload / Extract / Download buttons ---- import os from google.colab import files import ipywidgets as widgets from IPython.display import display, clear_output UPLOAD_DIR = "/content/combined_invoice_uploads" OUTPUT_XLSX = "/content/Combined_Extract.xlsx" os.makedirs(UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True) uploaded_paths = [] product_master_path = None upload_btn = widgets.Button(description="📁 Upload Invoices (PDF)", button_style="primary", layout=widgets.Layout(width="240px")) product_list_btn = widgets.Button(description="📋 Upload Master Catalog (optional)", button_style="warning", layout=widgets.Layout(width="290px")) process_btn = widgets.Button(description="⚙️ Extract, Match & Build Excel", button_style="success", layout=widgets.Layout(width="260px"), disabled=True) download_btn = widgets.Button(description="⬇️ Download Excel", button_style="info", layout=widgets.Layout(width="230px"), disabled=True) status = widgets.HTML(value="Step 1: Upload purchase and sale PDF invoices.") output_area = widgets.Output() def on_upload_clicked(b): global uploaded_paths with output_area: clear_output() picked = files.upload() clear_output() pdfs = {name: data for name, data in picked.items() if name.lower().endswith(".pdf")} if not pdfs: print("No PDF files selected.") return uploaded_paths = [] for name, data in pdfs.items(): path = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, name) with open(path, "wb") as f: f.write(data) uploaded_paths.append(path) print(f"Uploaded {len(uploaded_paths)} PDF(s).") status.value = f"Step 2: {len(uploaded_paths)} file(s) ready. Click Extract, Match & Build Excel." process_btn.disabled = False download_btn.disabled = True def on_product_list_clicked(b): global product_master_path with output_area: clear_output() picked = files.upload() clear_output() xlsx_files = {name: data for name, data in picked.items() if name.lower().endswith(".xlsx")} if not xlsx_files: print("No .xlsx file selected.") return name, data = next(iter(xlsx_files.items())) path = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, name) with open(path, "wb") as f: f.write(data) product_master_path = path print(f"Master product list loaded: {name}") def on_process_clicked(b): with output_area: clear_output() if not uploaded_paths: print("Please upload invoice PDF(s) first.") return sale_invoices, purchase_invoices = process_pdfs(uploaded_paths) if not sale_invoices and not purchase_invoices: print("No invoices parsed.") return if product_master_path: master = load_product_master(product_master_path) else: master = get_default_product_master() sale_apply_product_matching(sale_invoices, master) purchase_apply_product_matching(purchase_invoices, master) write_combined_workbook(sale_invoices, purchase_invoices, OUTPUT_XLSX) print(f"Done. Processed {len(sale_invoices)} sale and {len(purchase_invoices)} purchase invoice(s).") status.value = "Step 3: Workbook ready. Click Download Excel." download_btn.disabled = False def on_download_clicked(b): with output_area: if os.path.exists(OUTPUT_XLSX): files.download(OUTPUT_XLSX) else: print("Excel file not found.") upload_btn.on_click(on_upload_clicked) product_list_btn.on_click(on_product_list_clicked) process_btn.on_click(on_process_clicked) download_btn.on_click(on_download_clicked) display(widgets.VBox([ status, widgets.HBox([upload_btn, product_list_btn]), widgets.HBox([process_btn, download_btn]), output_area, ]))
